text: Free money. No catch. They left it.
Your boss matches your savings? Then watch this.
Researchers checked seven big American companies, in 1998.
Save a dollar, and the company adds more. Free.
These workers were over fifty-nine and a half. They could take it out any time, no penalty.
So skipping the match was just losing money.
Still, twenty to sixty percent left some on the table.
So researchers mailed them the math. Here's your free money.
Two months later? Almost nothing changed.
Knowing isn't taking. Free money only counts when you grab it.
